verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Terraform automates infrastructure 'on any cloud' via a public registry where 'anyone can publish and consume providers, modules, and policies,' and community evidence corroborates real multi-provider use (AWS cross-account work, a maintained Kubernetes provider) confirming the broad ecosystem in practice. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list/count of major cloud/SaaS providers and independent third-party verification of registry breadth beyond community anecdotes.
